jsonSchema.document: one JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 object schema describing the complete plugin-owned settings object accepted by ConfigApply
jsonSchema.references: local fragment references only; network and external-file references are forbidden
jsonSchema.empty: permitted only when the plugin accepts no application settings through ConfigApply

fields.role: optional presentation hints; never a substitute for JSON Schema validation
fields.compatibility: existing v1 field and field numbers remain unchanged

validation.requiredWhen: plugin accepts non-empty application settings through ConfigApply
validation.timing: the plugin validates the complete candidate ConfigApply JSON against this schema before changing active settings
validation.atomicity: schema or settings validation failure preserves the previous active revision and its resources
validation.transport: Gateway forwards ConfigSchema.json_schema unchanged and may use it for generic rendering or client-side validation

rejection.readiness: a plugin with non-empty settings and no valid json_schema must not acknowledge ConfigApply or report SERVING

security.noSecretValues: the schema may describe secret-reference fields but must not contain secret values, source paths, or credentials
